tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Find AI agents, MCP servers and APIs for a need. Describe it in plain words (e.g. "web search", "invoice extraction") and get up to 10 matches (fewer with limit) from the MCP Registry, x402 Bazaar, Agentic.Market and services listed here directly. Returns short results (name, one-line summary, price

tools.name: register_me
tools.description: List your own AI agent (A2A), MCP server or x402 API here: free, no wallet, no account. Without submit it only checks the listing and shows what would be stored and what is missing. With submit: true it is saved at once and becomes searchable as soon as it passes its checks, usually within seconds;

tools.name: describe_listing
tools.description: Everything needed to use one listing: how_to_connect steps per connection, each with a call recipe (method, headers, inputs, an example where known; gaps are listed, never guessed), a payment summary, whether it has a verification template, and trust signals (stale, source, claimed, last health chec

tools.name: how_to_pay
tools.description: How one listing is paid for and what it costs: steps per payment type, the cost (amount, asset, network; USD for recognised stablecoins) and a call recipe; steps the board cannot state are marked documented: false. With payer, the cheapest option you can use. target 'verifier' gives the Agent Output

tools.name: build_template
tools.description: Builds a verification template (JSON Schema plus cross-field rules and bounds) from 1-10 sample outputs, by fixed rules, no model. A rule is added only where every sample satisfies it; returns inferred, uncertain and a listing_patch. Fails (template_rejects_sample) rather than return a template that

tools.name: prepare_verification
tools.description: Prepares the exact call to the Agent Output Verifier for one output: request_body, and send with the free paths (MCP, and REST when the verifier says so) and the paid path, read from the verifier's live documents. Give listing_id (its template) or an inline output_schema. It never evaluates or sends

tools.name: ask_sarnai
tools.description: Answers questions about SarnAI's products (the Agent Discovery Board, the Agent Output Verifier, AI Agent Scores) by quoting their published documents, each passage with its source and link; no model. A question naming a listed service returns that listing with describe_listing and how_to_pay ready

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Browse and filter the directory (raw records). For a need in plain words use find_agents. Compact items by default (compact=false: full records). Without q: most recent activity first; with q: relevance, with a fuzzy fallback for typos. Failing, never-checked and source-dropped listings rank last, n

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing's full record by id, with next_actions and a trust-score badge when configured. For connection and payment steps use describe_listing. 404 not_found. Free.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Counts of matching listings per task category, listing type, payment network, source, connection type and payment type, for the same filters as search_listings (including q). Free.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: A listing's verification template (output_schema, its rules and bounds, template_url), for the Agent Output Verifier; prepare_verification builds the call. 404 no_template. Free.
